prompts.a-concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original protagonist style exploration board for Project Ember. Input image 1 is ONLY the earlier corpse identity/mood reference; redesign its rendering and simplify its overly detailed rags, do not inherit its layout or phototexture.
An ORIGINAL nameless adult human corpse awakened by a surviving ember after the world's stolen fire was extinguished. This playable corpse is NOT the ancient fire-stealing hero. Keep an actual human head, short irregular charred dark hair, ashen pale skin, sunken reddish eyes, a small slanted blood-marked chest wound containing a tiny orange ember. Simple charcoal short torn tunic, cropped dark trousers, pale wrist and calf wraps, a short dried-blood red waist tie, worn simple foot wraps. Only a few broad cloth tears. Class-neutral, no permanent weapon, armor, hood, cape, jewelry, crown, emblem or class costume. Compact adult proportions around 5.5 heads high, lean but capable limbs, clear hands and feet, moderately enlarged hands for gameplay readability. Menacing rekindled death with restrained local blood and char; bright enough to read. The same identity is essential across all views.
Style/medium: Dead Cells-inspired premium PIXEL ART interpretation: confident chunky authored pixel clusters and stepped contours, lean angular silhouette, energetic asymmetry, strong dark indigo/purple shadow planes with cool desaturated cyan reflected light and small vivid orange ember highlights. A limited coherent palette, large 2-3 tone material planes. No soft gradients, blur, painterly noise or photographic textures. Avoid the Beheaded's headless flame, iconic scarf and costume; keep our corpse's human head and original clothing.
Make a polished landscape concept sheet, approximately 1536x1024. Large full-body three-quarter hero on left (40% width), clean front and back full-body studies in middle (30%), a face/ember closeup and a small elevated-isometric GAMEPLAY LOOK MOCKUP on right (30%). Ground in mockup is readable medium gray ruined paving with broad quiet forms, no UI, no other characters. Show same proportions, clothing and hair across views. Keep neutral relaxed empty hands; no blade, bow or staff. Background flat light warm-gray presentation paper, not noisy or dark. Few restrained typographic labels only: "EMBER", "VARIANT A", "CONCEPT", "FRONT / BACK", "DETAIL", "GAMEPLAY LOOK". Show face is clearly an undead human. Prioritize clear shape and material blocks, not excessive detail or rag fringes. Entire bodies inside canvas, distinct feet, no cropped limbs, no extra limbs, no floating arms, no tiny unreadable annotations. This is a concept study, not a real game screenshot.

IMPORTANT layout: tall portrait sheet approximately 1024x1536. Header only 70px tall. EIGHT evenly spaced horizontal rows with THREE figure cells per row. All 24 cells equal size. Large gutters and generous padding so hands/feet never overlap cells or labels. Thin subtle cell separators are allowed. Matte plain medium-light gray background, no scenery, no drop shadows, no ground shadows. Small row labels in left gutter only. Three short column titles "CONTACT L", "PASS", "CONTACT R". Top title "A / WALK / 8 DIRECTIONS". Uniform body scale across entire sheet, fixed camera elevated 35 degrees, feet sit on a common per-row baseline. FULL bodies, not portraits. No extra poses outside grid.
Exactly EIGHT ROWS, from top to bottom:
ROW 1 "N" : facing screen UP, FULL BACK visible, face and chest ember HIDDEN.
ROW 2 "NE" : facing UPPER-RIGHT, BACK-RIGHT three-quarter, mostly back, right-pointing nose barely visible.
ROW 3 "E" : facing RIGHT, RIGHT PROFILE.
ROW 4 "SE" : facing LOWER-RIGHT, FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter.
ROW 5 "S" : facing DOWN toward viewer, full FRONT.
ROW 6 "SW" : facing LOWER-LEFT, FRONT-LEFT three-quarter.
ROW 7 "W" : facing LEFT, LEFT PROFILE.
ROW 8 "NW" : facing UPPER-LEFT, BACK-LEFT three-quarter, mostly back.
These are SCREEN directions from a fixed camera elevated 35 degrees. Turn the WHOLE torso/hips/feet with the head, not just the head. All three poses in a row face that row's direction. N/NE/NW must show backs, not front-facing heroes mislabeled.
ACTION in three columns: A brisk WALK-IN-PLACE cycle. Column 1 LEFT leg forward/right leg back, opposite arm counter-swing, hip weight down. Column 2 passing pose with feet close, right knee passing forward, body slightly taller. Column 3 RIGHT leg forward/left leg back, opposite arm counter-swing. Three clearly distinct physical poses, NOT three repeated standing figures. Direction is maintained; no root translation. Empty hands, no spell or attack. Torso lean modest and arms relaxed.
Do not merely rotate the image in its plane. Back views must be newly drawn. No new clothing, muscle bulk, missing or extra limbs, floating hands, detached wrists, hand duplication or hidden feet. Clean readable forms, no dense rag-fringe. Same tiny chest ember may remain, but completely hidden in full back views. This is a static keyframe source board, not an animated GIF and not a gameplay screenshot. Deliver the image containing every required direction and key pose.
Pixel enforcement: render every figure as around 75-source-pixel-tall authored game sprite at approximately 2x nearest-neighbor presentation. Conspicuous square pixel clusters and hard stepped edges. Large dark-blue shadow shapes and pale skin planes, at most 3 major tunic folds, no tiny rags, smooth painting or antialias. Match the refined A/PIXEL reference, not its discarded first draft.
